name: sparx — Pet Supplies (Premium)
tagline: A warm, working storefront for a premium pet brand.
description: A complete, working shop for a premium modern pet brand: a real catalogue of a hand-stitched leather collar and matching lead, an adventure harness, an orthopedic dog bed, a ceramic bowl, natural treats, a rope toy, a travel bottle, a grooming brush and a flexible subscription box, with categories, collections, a bespoke pet-shop PDP and a full merchandised home page. Warm, friendly-but-premium theme — a cream ground, a deep teal primary and a warm coral accent. Shipped as Barkwell.
